##### Project general facts

Seafora Villas is a premium residential project by DM Projects, an award-winning design and construction firm with over a decade of expertise in Southeast Asia. Founded by an architect and designer duo, the company brings an artistic vision to every villa, blending custom furniture, rare art, and exclusive materials. Villas features three bedrooms, a spacious living room, a dedicated office, a private pool, and a garden, all set on a generous plot with an unlocked ocean view.

Residents enjoy a thoughtfully designed living environment with a range of professional management services. The villa is maintained by an experienced international management company, ensuring year-round occupancy and careful operation. Services include grounds and unit maintenance, daily cleaning, linen replacement, appliance upkeep, utility management, 24/7 security, pool maintenance, landscaping, and comprehensive marketing and booking support. Monthly reporting and rental collection provide complete transparency for owners.

Every interior at Seafora Villas reflects a unique artistic vision, featuring custom furniture, rare art pieces, and exclusive materials selected by the founding designers. The living room offers generous space for relaxation and entertaining, while the kitchen is thoughtfully appointed. Bedrooms provide serene sanctuaries, and bathrooms feature premium finishes. The office space caters to remote work needs, and the terrace and private pool area create an ideal setting for indoor-outdoor tropical living.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the Ungasan area of the Bukit Peninsula, this exceptional location places residents in one of Bali’s most prestigious and rapidly developing coastal districts. Ungasan is renowned for its dramatic cliff-top views, pristine beaches, and a growing collection of world-class resorts, beach clubs, and fine dining establishments. The area offers an elevated microclimate with refreshing sea breezes and stunning ocean vistas.

The location is distinguished by its prime positioning and convenient access to key amenities. A new fitness centre is just moments away, while some of Bali’s most famous beaches, including Pandawa, Melasti, and Green Bowl, are within easy reach. The area is also home to international schools, luxury hotels, and the Bukit Pandawa Golf Club, making it highly desirable for families, digital nomads, and discerning travelers.

For those seeking a residence that embodies cliff-top luxury, natural beauty, and strong investment potential, Ungasan delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of ocean views, established infrastructure, and growing international demand makes it one of Bali’s most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali, serene, sophisticated and perfectly positioned.
